UserPromptSubmit.tool_input_type: absent (UserPromptSubmit carries no tool_input; the probe recorded tool_input_keys null on 3/3 rows)
UserPromptSubmit.note: Carries both `prompt` (the body) and `prompt_id`. The prompt_id is the design's 1st-tier correlation key and is also present on PreToolUse and SubagentStart on this host, so a UserPromptSubmit row can be joined to the spawns of the same turn.

verdict_rule: K1(a) — deriving the active model from a hook payload — is a go only if `model` is a top-level key of the event. It is absent on 3/3 UserPromptSubmit rows, so this event cannot source it.
observations: `model` is NOT a top-level key of UserPromptSubmit: documented as optional on the Agent tool's own input schema, but observed in 0/3 rows across 2 headless sessions on this host. The Agent tool schema (read from the probe session transcript's tool list) declares `model` as an optional string with enum [sonnet, opus, haiku, fable] — so the host has a notion of a per-spawn model, it just does not put one on this hook payload.

The key set is IDENTICAL on all 3 rows, including the second row of scenario b which fired after an Agent call returned — a mid-turn continuation is not distinguishable from a fresh prompt by key names alone.
Scenario b produced 2 rows from 1 user prompt. Row count is therefore NOT a count of user prompts; anything that meters per-prompt off this event would overcount on turns that use tools.
`permission_mode` is present here and on PreToolUse, but absent on SessionStart and SubagentStart on the same host — the four key sets are not nested.
The probe never writes the `prompt` VALUE, which is the reason this event is safe to instrument at all; the key's presence is the whole of what is recorded.
ndjson rows themselves live at ~/.claude/artibot/runtime/probe-keys.ndjson (value-free); the baseline was 15 lines and the two sessions appended 7.

whether `model` appears in a session where a non-default model was selected explicitly — both probe sessions ran the host default
the hook's OUTPUT contract (additionalContext injection, INCIDENT §7 D2) — this capture measured the INPUT key set only
